q: Turnaround time (TAT) ka formula kya hai?
explain: Turnaround time = Completion Time minus Arrival Time, yaani process ke aane se khatam hone tak ka total time.

q: Kaunsa scheduling algorithm non-preemptive algorithms mein minimum average waiting time deta hai (jab saare jobs ek saath aayein)?
explain: SJF chhote jobs pehle chalaata hai, isliye average waiting time sabse kam aata hai. Dikkat: starvation aur burst-time estimate.

q: FCFS mein jab ek lamba process ke peeche chhote processes atak jaate hain, use kya kehte hain?
explain: Convoy effect: FCFS mein bade BT wale process ke peeche chhote processes wait karte hain, average WT badh jaata hai.

q: Example A (P1 BT 24, P2 BT 3, P3 BT 3, sab AT 0) mein FCFS ka average waiting time kya hai?
explain: WT: P1=0, P2=24, P3=27. Sum=51, 51/3=17.00. Isi ko SJF 3.00 tak le aata hai.

q: Round Robin mein time quantum bahut bada rakh diya jaye to algorithm kaise behave karega?
explain: Bada quantum matlab har process ek hi slice mein pura chal jaata hai, to RR FCFS ki tarah behave karne lagta hai.
